Name: PivotedLandings
SQL:
-- sgl.query(PivotedLandings, many)
SELECT * FROM (SELECT harbour, species, kg FROM landings) AS l PIVOT (sum(kg) FOR species IN ('cod', 'hake'));
Template: SELECT ⟨star written 0=pivot.harbour 1=pivot.cod 2=pivot.hake:*⟩ FROM (SELECT harbour, species, kg FROM landings) AS l PIVOT (sum(kg) FOR species IN ('cod', 'hake'));

Name: NestedKilos
SQL:
-- sgl.query(NestedKilos, many)
SELECT x FROM (SELECT x FROM (SELECT kg AS x FROM landings) a) b;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0:x⟩ FROM (SELECT x FROM (SELECT kg AS x FROM landings) a) b;
